main.description: Create a new space. The space is anchored on the authenticated user's DID, who becomes the space authority. Its policy governs configuration, access, and tracked writers. Requires auth, implemented by PDS.

type.description: The NSID of the space type, describing the modality of the space (e.g. app.bsky.group, app.bsky.personal).

skey.description: The space key. Used to differentiate multiple spaces of the same type under the same owner. Same syntax requirements as a record key. If not provided, one will be auto-generated (TID).

policy.description: The space policy: the full configuration of the space.

errors.name: SpaceAlreadyExists
errors.description: A space with this owner, type, and skey already exists. A space that was previously deleted may be created again.

errors.name: UnsupportedPolicy
errors.description: A requested policy is not one the host implements.
